name: Forsyth County, NC
findings: Forsyth County has 1,473 nonprofit organizations. 576 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 457 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Forsyth County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 20 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.
